# Solver data flow {.unnumbered #solver-data-flow}

## ACC Magnetometer request {#acc-solver-request}

The ACC page converts Streamlit session state into four plain structures:

- Alkali-A configuration;
- optional Alkali-B configuration;
- active physical beams;
- common cell and static-field settings.

These structures are passed to `compute_alkali_system` and are suitable for caching because UI-only objects are removed first.

## Model construction {#model-construction}

For each species, `build_species_linear_model`:

1. builds the $|F,m\rangle$ basis;
2. evaluates every active beam at that species' transition frequencies;
3. sums optical population generators;
4. adds electron-randomization and uniform ground-state relaxation dynamics;
5. calculates density-dependent self-exchange information.

The one- or two-species steady-state solver then returns normalized populations and population Jacobians.

## Finalization {#species-finalization}

`_finalize_species` calculates:

- light-shift and magnetic state frequencies;
- population and coherence relaxation diagnostics;
- the Zeeman result table;
- optical readout operators.

`_evaluate_system_responses` then builds the shared secular RF context and
applies the common-field source to both ground manifolds. Atomic Fa/Fb moments
and total/rank/manifold optical readouts use the same resolvent.
`compute_alkali_responses` follows that same path when reusing a cached
population equilibrium. Display manifold choices do not enter the RF source
or equilibrium configuration.

## Physical-pump readout {#physical-pump-data-flow}

If the selected probe mode is physical, `apply_physical_pump_readout` stores the direct response as `probe_weak_response`, constructs dispersive and dissipative Stokes sources, evaluates their generalized Liouvillian responses, and applies the [uniform feedback closure](../theory/uniform-density-matrix-feedback.qmd#feedback-closure).

## Presentation and export {#presentation-and-export}

The page converts raw susceptibility units into the selected display units, applies optional sign flips only to displayed phase components, draws plots, and constructs CSV tables. Scientific transformations used by both plots and exports belong in reusable UI helpers so they can be regression tested.

## Time evolution request

The independent page calls `compute_density_evolution`, which reuses physical
beam, cell and collision-rate construction without invoking ACC finalization
or its RF solver. `coherent_evolution` builds collective optical Lindblad
jumps, the static and pump light-shift Hamiltonians, and full nuclear/electron
reduction maps. All integration uses a common lab basis; independently selected
quantization axes rotate only the reported density matrices. The pump-on and
dark integrations share their endpoint state. The page plots populations and
longitudinal moments, while `density_probe_signals` contracts the complete state
with the optical tensor. Complete CSVs include independent coherences.
See [equations, approximations and sampling](time-evolution.qmd).
